description: Hi! I'm Aayusha, a CS junior undergrad in the US and a massive space enthusiast. I would love to join your team for the Junior Astronaut challenge! I have a strong coding foundation and recently built a game using Unity, so I'm ready to dive straight into programming the game logic, Ul, and state management for our simulation.
summary: Lunar Last Light is an educational game where players help astronaut Luna and her crew keep a Moon base running through the long lunar night. Players choose tasks to manage supplies such as air, food, power, and protection while learning why the lunar night is challenging. They can also click stars to discover space facts and earn bonus points. Reach the point goal to unlock a solar system tour, where Luna flies past planets and shares facts about them. The game turns space science into a simple, interactive mission for students, with simplified values to make the choices easy to understand. It encourages players to explore, learn, and think about what astronauts need to live and work on the Moon.
details:
github link: https://github.com/cdaayushak/last-luna

Lunar Last Light is a browser game that introduces students to the challenge of surviving the Moon’s long night. Players guide astronaut Luna through four short levels, choosing tasks to keep the base’s air, food, power, and shelter supplies above zero until sunrise. Clickable stars reveal space facts and award points; earning 50 points unlocks a solar system flyby tour where Luna shares facts about the objects she passes.

The game makes space science interactive and approachable for younger students while still being enjoyable for older learners. We designed it with simple instructions, readable screens, and clear choices, while keeping the science grounded in real lunar conditions. The resource values are simplified for learning and are not real mission specifications. We also considered how to make the experience engaging through a lunar setting, animations, and Luna’s messages without overwhelming players with text.

The project was built with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS using Vite and Visual Studio Code. GitHub was used for source control and sharing the project. ChatGPT helped us brainstorm and speed up development.
